'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Heyo, brother. Got a new job for you. So, I've got an opportunity to open a new production line, but the problem is that some hustlers are hustling where they shouldn't hustle, and all the supplies I wanted to put into circulation have been scattered all over the city because of those pricks. Help me out, big guy?}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 100 [[Raiders]]
* Hand over 50 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] WARTECH brand equipment

==Rewards==
====BEAR Exclusive====
* Unlocks purchase of [[BEAR Classic]] clothing at [[Ragman]] LL2
* Unlocks purchase of [[BEAR Reitar]] clothing at [[Ragman]] LL2

====USEC Exclusive====
* Unlocks purchase of [[USEC AC Ranger Green upper]] clothing at [[Ragman]] LL2
* Unlocks purchase of [[USEC AC Ranger Green lower]] clothing at [[Ragman]] LL2

{{quote|Tremendous! The drip is now real.}}

==Guide==
